smell_elimination.justification: All inlined code has been systematically extracted into well-named helper functions. The einsum_path method is now clean and operates at a single abstraction level, with no residual inlined logic remaining.

cross_file_coordination.justification: The refactoring properly addresses all cross-file concerns. New helper functions are added to the same file (einsumfunc.py), maintaining proper module cohesion. No orphaned imports or unused helpers remain.

structural_soundness.justification: Excellent decomposition with each extracted function having a single, clear responsibility. The functions are properly scoped: _parse_path_type handles validation, _build_dimension_dict handles initialization, _compute_naive_cost handles calculation, _build_contraction_info encapsulates the complex contraction logic, and _format_path_output handles formatting. Each operates at the appropriate abstraction level.

code_quality.justification: The code is clean, well-documented with comprehensive docstrings, and uses descriptive names. The extracted functions have clear signatures and are easy to test in isolation. The main einsum_path method is now highly readable and maintainable.

fragment_identification.justification: All three levels of inlining are correctly identified: Level 1 (size calculation), Level 2 (_flop_count and _find_contraction logic), and Level 3 (_can_dot BLAS validation with 30+ lines). The refactoring captures every inlined fragment despite variable renames.

extraction_quality.justification: Each extracted method has a clear, focused purpose at the right abstraction level. _parse_path_type handles input validation, _build_dimension_dict handles dimension setup, _compute_naive_cost handles FLOP estimation, _build_contraction_info encapsulates the entire contraction computation (including the deeply nested BLAS logic), and _format_path_output handles output formatting. All three levels of inlining are correctly unwound.

helper_function_extraction_completeness.justification: All inlined logic is comprehensively extracted. The 30+ lines of _can_dot BLAS validation logic, the ~20 lines of _find_contraction set operations, and the duplicate _flop_count calculations are all now properly encapsulated in _build_contraction_info. Path parsing logic is in _parse_path_type, dimension building in _build_dimension_dict, naive cost calculation in _compute_naive_cost, and output formatting in _format_path_output. The einsum_path method now reads as a clear, high-level orchestration of these steps with no algorithmic details exposed.

aspect_3_judge.summary: This is an exemplary refactoring that systematically eliminates all three levels of method inlining. Every piece of inlined logic has been extracted into appropriately named, well-documented helper functions with clear single responsibilities. The einsum_path method is transformed from an extremely complex 200+ line function operating at multiple abstraction levels into a clean, readable orchestrator that delegates all details to focused helpers, making the code significantly more maintainable, testable, and understandable.
